testimonials.quote: The audio and video quality was superb, and the team was friendly, warm, and professional.
For those of us unable to travel to the ceremony, the live stream provided the opportunity to share the experience and be moved by the occasion.

awards_press: Featured vendor badge on The Knot

content.description_seo: Wedding Livestreams is a San Diego-based wedding livestreaming and cinematic film company led by Horacio Jones, founder of the video production company CinemaViva. The team serves San Diego, Orange County, and Los Angeles with tiered livestream-only, film-only, and hybrid packages, ranging from a single-camera $995 essential stream to a multi-camera cinematic hybrid package. Every livestream is delivered through a private link with no app or account required for guests, and the crew brings bonded cellular and Starlink internet so the stream keeps running even at venues with poor or no Wi-Fi. Same-day HD recordings are provided after the ceremony, and the company has been featured as a vendor on The Knot.
content.one_line_summary: San Diego livestream + cinematic film company led by Horacio Jones of CinemaViva, with tiered live/film/hybrid packages from $995 and bonded-cellular/Starlink backup connectivity.

faq_items.q: What if my venue doesn't have Wi-Fi?
faq_items.a_summary: Bonded cellular and Starlink are brought to every wedding so the stream doesn't depend on venue Wi-Fi.

faq_items.q: Can we combine livestream and a wedding film?
faq_items.a_summary: Yes — Hybrid packages bundle a livestream with a full edited ceremony film and highlight video.

faq_items.q: How soon do we get the recording?
faq_items.a_summary: A same-day HD recording is provided right after the ceremony.
